subject: Quick POC demo — scope, volume & timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@bluecart.ai>
Date: 2026-08-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Following up on your Redwood self-serve signup

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for trying Redwood! I saw you signed up and I wanted to quickly run through a couple of items so we can tailor the demo to what matters for BlueCart:

- Primary use case (a short sentence is fine): what feature do you want to validate in the POC?
- Monthly volume estimates (requests and embedding lookups) and any expected burst/peak patterns
- Timeline: target date for POC kickoff and production goal

If youre open, I can set up a focused 30-min POC demo this week or next — well cover architecture, expected latency, embedding throughput, and a short Q&A on security.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 8/17 10:30–11:00
- Tue 8/17 14:00–14:30
- Wed 8/18 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, tell me a couple times that do. Also happy to drop a short pre-demo checklist if you want to loop in engineering/security.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

----
Attachment stubs: none on this message
From: Daniel Park <daniel@bluecart.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Following up on your Redwood self-serve signup

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the note and glad to connect. Quick answers below:

- Use case: in-app summarization (short text summaries for shopping receipts) + similarity search for product recommendations (embeddings).
- Volume: roughly 500k generation requests/month (short prompts, avg 30 tokens), and ~2M embedding queries/month from search indexing. Peak traffic during US evening hours (approx 2x baseline).
- Timeline: wed like to run a POC in the next 6–8 weeks and aim to move to production by early Q1 2027.

A few concerns up front: PII handling (we have order data with customer names), and data residency — we prefer US-only processing for now.

I can do Tue 8/17 at 14:00 PDT or Wed 8/18 at 09:00 PDT. Please include any security folks if possible.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Platform, BlueCart AI
daniel@bluecart.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@bluecart.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-17T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Following up on your Redwood self-serve signup

Great — thanks for the details, Daniel. That helps a lot. A few quick follow-ups so we make the demo actionable:

1) Peak TPS: when you say ~2x baseline at peak, any sense of absolute peak queries/sec for embeddings? (~50 TPS vs 200 TPS makes a different config recommendation)
2) Latency SLO: are you targeting 200ms p95 for in-app calls or is higher acceptable during POC?
3) PII/data handling: is BlueCart comfortable with token-level pseudonymization before sending to the model, or does this need to stay in a US-only VPC/on-prem?
4) Engineering attendees: will your infra/security leads join? if so, please share names/emails so we can invite them.

Well run the demo focused on embedding throughput and tail latency, plus our PII handling options (VPC + customer-managed KMS). Ill hold the two slots you accepted on Daniels side for now (Tue 14:00, Wed 09:00) while Lauren picks the best one and sends the invite.

I can also share a short security checklist and a one-pager ahead of the session.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

----
Attachment stubs: requested security checklist (security-questionnaire.pdf), sample ROI worksheet (ROI-estimate.xlsx)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@bluecart.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-17T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Following up on your Redwood self-serve signup

Hi Daniel —

Im Lauren, the AE on your account — great to meet you. Thanks for the volume and timeline context. Well make the demo highly tactical: 30 minutes covering

- POC success criteria (what a minimal POC looks like)
- Embedding throughput and cost estimates for your 2M/mo workload
- Tail/peak latency and strategies to keep p95 low during evening spikes
- PII/data residency options (VPC + KMS, tokenization patterns, and audit logging)

Monica (ccd) will join to speak to onboarding and the pre-demo checklist. Ive set the demo for Tue 2026-08-17 14:00–14:30 PDT (per your availability) — please let me know if you prefer Wed 09:00 instead.

Ive attached a short product one-pager and a calendar invite. If you have security folks who want to join, Monica will follow up with the checklist and our SOC2 summary.

Attachments: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf (1 page), calendar-invite.ics (30-min invite)

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs included: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf, calendar-invite.ics

Subject: Re: Following up on your Redwood self-serve signup

Lauren —

Thanks, Tue 14:00 works for us. Monica please share the pre-demo checklist and SOC2 summary when you can. Two quick asks for the demo:

- Can you include a short note on how you measure jitter and tail behavior in production (p95 vs p99)?
- Wed like to see an example of how Redwoods embedding index performs on a small sample of our product catalog data; I can send a 1000-row CSV ahead of time.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Daniel
